literal_meaning: বারবার নাড়া বা নড়চড় করা (reduplicative form of নাড়া meaning to stir or move)
figurative_meaning_en: Echo word; repeated fidgeting or fiddling around
example_sentences_in_english: The child keeps fidgeting throughout the class.
Don't fiddle with the things on the table.
note: This is a typical Bengali reduplicative expression used to describe restless or unnecessary movement.
